headline: President Obama's 2011 order updated four earlier executive orders, renewed a body set up under another, and canceled a fifth order.
what_it_does: This order changes the text of four earlier executive orders (12824, 12835, 12859, and 13532). It reestablishes a group or office first created under Executive Order 13498. It also fully cancels Executive Order 13507. The title does not explain the specific changes, so their details are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: White House offices and federal agencies
who_it_affects.how: They may have new or changed duties, structures, or reporting lines under the amended and revoked orders.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 5, 2011; the effective date is not stated in the title.
